name: migratory

verify.full: make up && make bootstrap && make verify
notes: make verify is the gate for every change (build, vet, race tests, boundary lint).
Integration tests skip when the dev stack is down; CI fails on 'postgres not reachable', so a local skip is not a pass.
CI also runs gofmt -l, the exit-gate and p3-gate commands and helm lint.

invariants: Single writer: only the assertion writer writes instance/graph state.
History is immutable (supersession, no raw UPDATE); projection == fold(log, policy).
asOf uses observed_at (valid time); delta and Diff use ingested_at (transaction time); use provenance.DBNow, not the process clock.
Provenance is required on every fact.
RLS applies everywhere including tests; the tenant comes from the credential; register new routes in apiReadPaths/apiWriteRoutes.
Masking happens before egress, including exports, LLM calls and logs.
Module dependency rules are CI-enforced (make arch).
No stack substitution without a docs/DEVIATIONS.md entry.
